name: The Tide House
tagline: Coastal California seafood, sourced daily off the San Diego shoreline
description: The Tide House is a relaxed coastal restaurant overlooking the San Diego harbor, serving sustainable seafood, raw bar selections, and California wines. We focus on whole-fish preparations, local oysters, and produce from regional farms. Open for lunch and dinner seven days a week.

holiday_hours.note: Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Christmas Eve we close at 18:00. Open New Year's Eve until midnight with a special menu.

happy_hour.note: Happy hour runs Monday through Friday from 3 to 5 PM in the bar lounge and on the patio.

reservation_policy.cancellation_policy: Cancel more than 24 hours in advance to avoid any fee. Parties of 6+ cancelled within 24 hours may be charged $20 per person.

mains.name: Wagyu Burger

drinks.name: Harbor Margarita
drinks.description: Blanco tequila, lime, agave, salt rim

bar.note: Six bar seats, walk-in only, full menu available. The bar opens at 11:30 (10:00 on weekends) and stays open through close.

seating.outdoor_note: We have a covered patio with harbor views — six tables, weather permitting. Patio seating is reservable on the same terms as indoor.
seating.special_requests_note: Patio tables go quickly on weekends — request when booking and we'll do our best.

parking.street_parking: Limited metered parking on Harbor Walk and surrounding blocks; free after 6 PM.
parking.valet: Valet available Thursday through Sunday from 5 PM, $15.
parking.garage: Public garage at 1500 Harbor Walk, two blocks south, $5 flat after 6 PM.

accessibility.note: Step-free entrance from Harbor Walk, accessible restrooms, two wheelchair-friendly tables on the main floor. Patio access has a small lip — please mention if assistance is needed.

auto_gratuity.note: 20% auto-gratuity is added to checks for parties of 6 or more.

payment.split_checks: We can split checks up to 4 ways per table; larger splits at the server's discretion.
payment.corkage: Corkage is $25 per 750ml bottle, two-bottle limit. We waive corkage on Mondays.

kids.note: We have a kids menu with smaller portions of fish, pasta, and sliders. High chairs and booster seats are available — just ask the host when you arrive.

allergens.note: Please let us know about any allergies when booking and again when you arrive — we will work with you to find safe options. Common allergen flags appear on the menu but always confirm with your server.

private_dining.note: Our private dining room seats up to 24 with harbor-facing windows. Available for lunch and dinner. Contact reservations for menus and minimums.

special_occasions.note: We're happy to make birthdays, anniversaries, and engagements memorable — let us know when booking so we can prep a card or a candle on a dessert. We do not charge a cake fee for outside cakes (please coordinate ahead).

corkage.note: $25 per 750ml bottle, two-bottle limit, waived on Mondays. We do not allow outside spirits.

pets.note: Service animals are always welcome. Well-behaved leashed dogs are welcome on the patio. Pets are not permitted inside the dining room.

ambiance.note: Casual coastal — exposed wood, blue-and-white palette, big windows facing the harbor. Music kept low enough for conversation. Smart casual dress, no jacket required.

sourcing.philosophy: We work directly with San Diego fishermen and California farms wherever possible. Our oysters are from California growers (rotating); our halibut and white fish are wild-caught from the Pacific.
sourcing.note: Our menu changes with what's coming off the boats. Servers can talk through what's local that day.
